patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the 'Game.rgss3a' file from the downloaded patch archive into the game install folder mentioned above, overwriting the file when prompted It's working if: When you watch the H scene in the initial sequence, there are no flowers covering sensitive areas. uncensorpat.ch checked this patch on PC.
